{{See also|Changes from vanilla}}
[[Matcha Flavoured]] renames many vanilla items, blocks and villager professions through its resource pack's language file. Datapacks cannot add new items, so the pack also gives most of its custom items the ID of an unused or repurposed vanilla item; for example [[Obol]]s are emeralds, [[Divine Fragment|divine fragments]] are turtle scutes and [[Benzene|benzene]] is an endermite spawn egg. Both kinds appear in the table below.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/lang/en_us.json}}</ref>

The distinction matters for commands and mod compatibility: <code>/give @s minecraft:emerald</code> gives an obol, and a vanilla item the pack repurposes no longer exists under its vanilla name. Several vanilla items were renamed to fit the setting: everything "Nether" is "Hell", netherite is [[Adamant Alloy|adamant]], shulker boxes are [[Sack|sacks]] and redstone is [[Electric Wire|electric wire]].
